answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 65600 Country: India Title: Inheritance Question: Please guide me how to divide Rs10 lakhs among 8 brother and 3 sister? Answer ID: 65600 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 896/889/N=09/1437) If there are only 8 brothers and 3 sisters among the heir of any deceased person and he/she has left 10 lakh rupees then it shall be divided as per the below mentioned method: Each brother shall get 105363.15 while each sister shall get 52631.57 as a brother/son gets just double of what a sister/daughter gets. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
